Як сказати, де щось є: in, on, at, а ще: How to say where something is: in, on, at, and also under, behind, in front of, next to, between, opposite, above and below. Plus fixed phrases: at home, at school, in bed, on the bus.
in: всередині чогось (кімната, коробка,: in: inside something (a room, a box, a city, a country)
My phone is inside my bag.
on: на поверхні (стіл, стіна, підлога, п: on: on a surface (a table, a wall, the floor, a shelf)
A poster is hanging on the wall.
at: у точці або там, де щось відбуваєтьс: at: at a point or where something happens
Let’s meet at the bus stop.
under, behind, in front of, next to, bet: under, behind, in front of, next to, between: exactly where something is
The cat is under the bed, by my shoes.
Сталі вирази: at home, at school, at wor: Fixed phrases: at home, at school, at work, in bed, on the bus
Dan is still in bed, but Lily is already at school.
всередині: in the box, in the kitchen, i: inside: in the box, in the kitchen, in the car, in Lviv, in the photo, in the sky
на поверхні: on the table, on the wall,: on a surface: on the table, on the wall, on the floor, on the bus, on the screen, on the left
точка або подія: at the door, at the bus: a point or an event: at the door, at the bus stop, at the party, at home, at school, at work
під / позаду / перед: under the table, b: below / at the back of / at the front of: under the table, behind the sofa, in front of the house
поруч / між двома / навпроти: next to me: beside / in the middle of two / facing: next to me, between Max and Lily, opposite the bank
вище / нижче, не торкаючись: above the d: higher / lower, not touching: above the door, below the window
Без артикля кажемо at home, at school, a: With no article we say at home, at school, at work, in bed. Not in home, not at bed and not at the home.
on the bus, але in the car: on the bus, but in the car
У великому транспорті, де можна стояти і: For big transport where you can stand and walk (bus, train, plane) we say on. For a car or a taxi we say in.
next to і in front of: не губи маленькі: next to and in front of: don’t lose the small words
Next to складається з двох слів (з to, б: Next to has two words (with to, no of), in front of has three (with of). Opposite and between need no extra words.

вгорі / внизу сторінки: at the highest / lowest part of the page

на стіні / на підлозі: on the surface of the wall / the floor
ліворуч / праворуч: on the left side / the right side
по телевізору / на екрані: shown on TV / on a screen

Раунд 2. Під, позаду, поруч, між: Round 2. Under, behind, next to, between
The cat is hiding below the bed: under.
At the back of the sofa, so you can’t see it: behind.
Між двома людьми: between. Next без to і: In the middle of two people: between. Next without to and in front without of are incomplete, and among is for three or more.
Лампа висить над столом і не торкається: The lamp hangs higher than the table without touching it: above.
Facing it, across the street: opposite.
At the front of the house: in front of, three words.
Поверхом нижче: below. Above означало б: One floor lower: below. Above would mean higher.
In the middle of two buildings: between.
At the front of the cinema: in front of.

In the middle of two people: between.
Біля головного входу, перед будівлею: in: By the main entrance, at the front of the building: in front of.
At the back of the curtain: behind.
